# $\mathrm{Cr}_3$ of a function field over a finite field is not generated by pseudo-regularizable elements

Let $F$ be a finite field and let $X$ be a variety over $F$ of positive dimension, with
function field $F(X)$. The Cremona group $\mathrm{Cr}_3(F(X))$, the group of birational
automorphisms of affine $3$-space over $F(X)$, is not generated by its pseudo-regularizable
elements.

This is Theorem 1.2 (1) (c) of Lin and Shinder.

## Sources

- Hsueh-Yung Lin and Evgeny Shinder, *Motivic invariants of birational maps*, Annals of Mathematics 199 (2024), no. 1, 445–478. Statement taken from https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/AnnalsChallenge. Problem `annals_motivic_invariants` of the lean-eval benchmark.
